## Validation

<!-- List checks actually run and any platform or runtime limits. -->

- [ ] Rust formatting, tests and Clippy pass with the pinned toolchain.
- [ ] Pawn encoding and native declarations pass the source check.
- [ ] A changed native is registered, declared in the template and used by an example.
- [ ] Changes affecting the AMX boundary have appropriate runtime coverage.
- [ ] Dependency changes include an updated cargo-about inventory review.
- [ ] Documentation and the pending release changelog match the change.
- [ ] Changed documentation passes `cargo xtask gen-api --check` and `cargo xtask docs`.
- [ ] Commits include Signed-off-by.

## Contribution rights

- [ ] I have read and followed the AI usage policy.
- [ ] I have read the DCO and CLA; my sign-off certifies the DCO and accepts the CLA.
- [ ] Every author and co-author has supplied their own sign-off.
- [ ] Third-party sources, licenses and required employer authorizations are disclosed.
